claim_boundary: This protocol defines admissible data and evaluation semantics. Existing research-probe scores are not promoted by this file.

whole_spacecraft_adcs_paired_dataset_v5_.reason: Thirty independent trajectory_pair_id groups support frozen 60/20/20 grouped train/validation/test evaluation; conclusions remain synthetic engineering evidence.

whole_spacecraft_phm_dataset_v6_0.reason: Ten Monte Carlo groups are split by sample_index with all operating phases retained in one partition; the 560 new samples cover EPS, thermal, comm/data, payload and propulsion.

new_campaign.independence_requirement: A new independence_group_id requires at least one consumed simulator parameter, initial-state, command/load profile, or stochastic-process draw to differ. Changing only onset, output path, run_id, or recorded-but-unused seed does not create an independent group.

required_partitions.development: May fit representations and model parameters; no final claim.
required_partitions.calibration: May select thresholds, temperature scaling, abstention and top-k policy; cannot fit representation weights.
required_partitions.test_id: Frozen in-distribution groups; no fit, selection or ontology edits.
required_partitions.test_condition_ood: Unseen initial conditions and command/load or mission profiles.
required_partitions.test_severity_ood: Frozen lower and boundary severities not used for threshold selection.
required_partitions.test_open_set: Unknown fault modes plus nominal transients; must permit UNKNOWN.
required_partitions.test_multi_fault: Concurrent faults with explicit source and affected-component truth.

generation_gates: sample seed or parameter-draw identifier is consumed and attested
pre-fault trajectory diversity is non-zero where the plan claims condition variation
counterfactual fault-versus-paired-nominal observability passes on source-local and propagated channels
source execution, numerical, conservation, mission and calibration statuses are reported separately
a top-level validation PASS cannot mask an ineligible source status
label, truth, case, path, scenario, seed and split fields are stored only in evaluator sidecars

detection.operational_task: Causal continuous-stream event detection with unknown onset
detection.representation_probe: Known-window fault-versus-nominal discrimination; must be reported separately and never called detection accuracy
detection.primary_algorithm: Causal component residual bank: robust rolling nominal or independent digital-twin prediction, physics-normalized residuals, lightweight logistic/HGB event scorer and hysteresis
detection.challenger: Smooth grey-box residual network with bounded learnable component parameters; raw CNN is not the default
prohibited_shortcuts: fault_active or injected onset used by inference
each run's own pre-fault segment supplied to only its positive example while nominal negatives are exact zero residuals
other-component propagated faults omitted from false-positive accounting

localization.task: Hierarchical source localization: subsystem then component archetype, with affected components reported separately
localization.primary_algorithm: Train-only normalized z-statistics and residual signatures with multinomial logistic baseline
localization.challenger: Physics-gated lightweight MLP over source-local, command-response and propagation residual groups
localization.instance_policy: Instance-level localization is eligible only when each component class has multiple independently varied physical instances or axes.

classification.task: Component-conditioned hierarchy: mechanism family then component-local fault mode, with UNKNOWN for unsupported combinations
classification.primary_algorithm: Component equation residual features plus hierarchical regularized logistic/HGB heads
classification.challenger: Continuous smooth grey-box network whose bounded learnable parameters correct component equations before a small hierarchical MLP
classification.deferred_algorithm: TFM or large temporal transformer is deferred until independent support per component-mechanism cell and cross-condition validation justify its capacity.
ontology_gates: No cross-component mechanism label is trainable unless it has repeated support across at least two component archetypes and distinguishable governed residual signatures.
Classes without adequate independent support remain evaluation-only or UNKNOWN and are not merged after observing test results.
Macro-F1 includes every truth-supported class, including classes with zero true positives.

required_views: each stage with oracle upstream input
each stage with predicted upstream input
failure attribution by first wrong stage
cascade_evaluation.promotion_rule: No stage or cascade enters the downstream knowledge/LLM capability claim until the frozen test manifests, metric implementation tests, leakage audit and confidence intervals are complete.
